root.name: English Opening: Romanishin Gambit
root.moves: 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 a6 4. Bg2 b5

overview: Black pushes ...b5 right away in the Catalan-style English, inviting 5.cxb5 axb5 so the a-file opens and Black's pieces become active. White can try to keep the extra b5 pawn with Nc3 and d4, while Black's rook on the a-file and bishop on b7 pressure the long diagonal. The idea is to use open lines on the queenside; White often returns the pawn for safety. I am unsure of how often the pawn truly stays given.

white_ideas.idea: Take on b5 and aim for Nc3, d4 and a solid extra pawn
Decline with a4 or b3 and keep a sound structure

black_ideas.idea: Open the a-file and play ...Bb7, ...Qb6 and ...Be7 for queenside pressure
Strike in the centre with ...c5 or ...d5 once White's pieces are uncoordinated

typical_structures.structure: Open a-file with Black bishop on the long diagonal and White fianchettoed bishop on g2

character.notes: Opens the queenside early with the pawn offer; sharper than the usual quiet English.

gambit.notes: After 5.cxb5 axb5 Black is offering the b5 pawn for open lines; White can keep it with accurate play.

soundness.notes: Probably dubious since White can pick up material, but the compensation is not trivial.

structure.notes: Flank pawn play and the centre is still undecided.

level.notes: Needs judgement about when to regain material.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.cxb5 axb5 6.Nc3
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 a6 4. Bg2 b5 5. cxb5 axb5 6. Nc3
sublines_that_differ.how: The testing reply, attacking the b5 pawn.

character.reason: Early ...b5 opens the queenside and creates concrete tactical problems.

gambit.reason: Black offers the b-pawn for open lines and White may keep it.

soundness.reason: The compensation is probably not enough against accurate play.

structure.reason: The centre stays undecided while the fight is on the flank.

approach.reason: Strong players rarely choose the Romanishin Gambit.

level.reason: A dubious line is never Beginner and play is judgement-led.

plans.reason: Black aims at open queenside files, closest to the half-open file plan.
